mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO notification_fanout_job (event_id, actor_id, resource_id, summary) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{actorId}, #{resourceId}, #{summary})
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_fanout_job SET status = 'IN_FLIGHT', claim_token = #{token}, lease_until = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 120 SECOND), attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE ((status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (status = 'IN_FLIGHT' AND lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))) ORDER BY created_at, event_id LIMIT 1

UPDATE notification_fanout_job SET follower_cursor = #{cursor}, attempts = 0, status = CASE WHEN #{done} THEN 'DONE' ELSE 'PENDING' END, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{done} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE NULL END, claim_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'IN_FLIGHT' AND claim_token = #{token}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification_fanout_job WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY', 'IN_FLIGHT')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification_fanout_job WHERE status = 'DEAD'
SELECT COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, MIN(created_at), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)), 0) FROM notification_fanout_job WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY', 'IN_FLIGHT')
